summary: Applied 4 spec review repairs covering recoverable gate scope, review baselines, evidence mapping, and recovery artifact schema.

items.title: Gate recovery scope conflicts with tracked gate phases
items.rationale: Limited audited gate recovery to task-impl/integration and specified recoveryPossible:false for tracked gate draft/spec exhaustion.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in, constraints, requirements R2, acceptance_criteria, and clarifications now define supported and unsupported gate phases.

items.title: Review recovery has no persisted failure baseline
items.rationale: Added a requirement that review FAIL/stop handling persists phase-specific recovery baseline fingerprints.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2], overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, and implementationTargets now name the review baseline contract.

items.title: Evidence source mapping is undefined
items.rationale: Added a bounded kind/phase evidence source mapping and changedEvidence summary fields shared by reset, next-action, status, and tests.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints and requirements R4/R5/R8 now define the mapping, unchanged rejection, and display fields.

items.title: Recovery artifact target is unspecified
items.rationale: Named retry-recovery.json and specified its versioned append-only entry shape.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, requirements[5], acceptance_criteria, clarifications, keywords, and tasks now define the artifact path and fields.
